title: Course outline constraints
description: Machine-checkable outline constraints for a course type. Semantics: ranges + required-only, NEVER equality. Only fields present in a preset file are checked; absent fields are unconstrained.

module_count.description: Allowed range for the number of modules in docs/01-outline/.

lab_ratio.description: Allowed range for labs / modules (0-1 float).

required_assessment_types.description: Assessment types that must be declared in the outline. Required-only semantics: listed types must appear, additional types are allowed.

total_hours.description: Allowed range for total course hours, checked only when the outline declares total hours.

lessons_per_module_max.description: Upper bound for lessons referenced inside a single module.

first_module_type.description: Expected type of the first module (e.g. "introduction"). Matched against the first module file name/heading, case-insensitive.
